content: Bellwood General Hospital was a medical facility located in Bellflower, California. The hospital ceased operations on April 6, 2003. On February 2, 1982, the hospital was acquired by Paracelsus Healthcare Corporation. The corporation later faced allegations of defrauding Medicare at two of its facilities: Orange County Community Hospital (OCCH) and Bellwood General Hospital. To resolve these allegations, Paracelsus Healthcare Corporation paid a settlement of $3 million. As part of its bankruptcy proceedings, Paracelsus Healthcare Corporation either sold or closed all of its hospitals, including Bellwood General Hospital, which was ultimately shut down. Despite the closure of Bellwood General Hospital, a psychiatric health facility known as Bellwood Health Facility, licensed by the Office of Statewide Health Planning and Development (OSHPD), continues to operate adjacent to the original hospital site.
